t: Seder tepillot aseret yeme teshuba verosh hashshana
s: Seder tepillot aseret yeme teshuba verosh hashshana ubo y"z seipim: kol hashshana adam mitpallel "hael haqqadosh" bibraka g' u"melek oheb tzedaqa umishpat" bibraka y"a, chutz measara yamim shebben rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim shebbahen tzarik lomar "hammelek haqqadosh" "hammelek hammishpat", lepi shebbayyamim hallalu haqqadosh baruk hu mareh malkuto lishpot et haolam. Veim taa veamar "hael haqqadosh", o shehu mesuppaq im amar "hammelek haqqadosh", im nizkar leachar sheshshaha kede sheilat shalom talmid lerabbo achar gemar habberaka, veen tzarik lomar im nizkar leachar shehitchil beraka rebiit — tzarik lachazor lerosh hattepilla, mippene sheshshalosh berakot rishonot chashubot keachat:

Veim nizkar qodem sheshshaha kede shiur hazzeh — omer "hammelek haqqadosh", veeno tzarik lachazor larosh. Veken haddin be"hammelek hammishpat". Veim nizkar leachar sheshshaha kede shiur hazzeh sheamar "melek oheb tzedaqa umishpat" — eno tzarik lachazor larosh, kevan shehizkir leshon malkut. Veyesh omerim deim nizkar qodem shessiyyem tepillato chozer lerosh birkat "hashiba", veim nizkar leachar shessiyyem tepillato chozer lerosh hattepilla, veal derek shennitbaer besiman qy"z, mishshum deyesh hepresh ben "melek oheb tzedaqa umishpat" le"hammelek hammishpat", dibkol hashshana hatztzedaqa iqqar ulekak hiqdimuha lemishpat, abal bayyamim hallalu hammishpat iqqar ulekak en mazkirin tzedaqa kelal. Uleinyan halaka sepeq berakot lehaqel, ulepikak im nizkar qodem shessiyyem tepillato — en tzarik lachazor lebirkat "hashiba", kede shello yebarek sepeq beraka lebattala, abal leachar sheaqar raglayv — tob sheyyitpallel od paam betorat nedaba, veeno tzarik lechaddesh bah dabar kevan shemmitpallel otah mechamat hassapeq kemo shennitbaer besiman q"z:

Im amar tz' peamim "baruk atta Hashem hammelek haqqadosh" o "baruk atta Hashem hammelek hammishpat" veachar kak nistappeq lo battepilla im amar "hammelek haqqadosh" — ap al pi ken tzarik lachazor larosh ledibre hakkol. Veeno domeh lemah shennitbaer besiman qy"d, dekan kevan sheeno rashshay lomar hashshem kiqriato mishshum beraka lebattala, veim ken battepilla kesheomer et hashshem kiqriato — hu chozer lelimmudo lomar "hael haqqadosh":

Beshabbat teshuba, veken im chal rosh hashshana o yom hakkippurim beshabbat, omer hashsheliach tzibbur bibraka meen sheba shebbelel shabbat "hammelek haqqadosh", vechotem beshel shabbat lebad, veeno mazkir lo rosh hashshana velo yom hakkippurim, mittaam shennitbaer besiman rs"ch:

Yesh nohagin lehitpallel berosh hashshana ubeyom hakkippurim bikria, utzerikim hem lizqop bitchillat kol beraka ubesop kol beraka qodem sheyyomar "baruk atta", kede shello yehe nireh kemosip al taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu lishchot bitchillat birkat abot ubesopah ubitchillat birkat hodaa ubesopah ayyen besiman qy"g, ubebirkat abot ubebirkat hodaa tzarik lizqop kesheyyaggia leezeh tebot qodem hachatima, veachar kak kesheyyaggia lehachatima yishcheh ketaqqanat chakamim, mittaam shennitbaer sham:

Haggeonim tiqqenu lomar baaseret yeme teshuba bebirkat abot "zakerenu", ubigburot "mi kamoka", ubehodaa "uketob", ub"sim shalom" "beseper". Veim shakach leomram venizkar qodem shessiyyem habberaka sheshshakach bah — omeram bammaqom shennizkar. Veim nizkar leachar shehizkir et hashshem shebbachatimat habberaka — lo yomar bammaqom shennizkar, vegam lo yachazor lerosh habberaka, mishshum issur beraka lebattala, kevan deenan ella tiqqun haggeonim:

"Lechayyim" yomar bishba"a tachat hallame"d, velo yomar bepatta"ch, dela lishtamma "lachayyim", kelomar lo chayyim, ubayyamim haellu shehen yeme din tzarik ledaqdeq uleparet heteb tepillato. Abal bishar yemot hashshana anu omerim: "vehaamidenu malkenu lachayyim" bepatta"ch, veen anu chosheshin, lepi sheachar kavvanat halleb hen hen haddebarim:
Velo yomar "lechayyim tobim", raq "lechayyim", ad sheyyaggia le"uketob lechayyim ku'", az yomar: "lechayyim tobim", ki hambaqqesh tzarik lebaqqesh techilla dabar muat veachar kak mosip veholek:

Berosh hashshana omer "vattitten lanu et yom hazzikkaron hazzeh", veen tzarik lehazkir rosh chodesh velomar "veet yom rosh chodesh hazzeh", diksheomer "yom hazzikkaron" gam rosh chodesh biklal, shenniqra zikkaron, shenneemar "ubeyom simchatkem ubemoadekem uberashe chodshekem vego' venizkartem". Im chal bechol omerim battepilla ubaqqiddush "yom terua miqra qodesh", veim chal beshabbat omerim "zikron terua":

Berosh hashshana veyom kippur en omerim "moadim lesimcha chaggim uzemannim lesason", mippene sheyyamim ellu lo nittenu lesimcha ulesason. Veken en omerim "vehassienu et birkat moadeka ku'", lepi sheddabar zeh lo neemar ella beshalosh regalim shenneemar "shalosh peamim bashshana vego' kebirkat Hashem eloheka vego'. Ubemusap en omerim "veen anu yekolim laalot veleraot lepaneka", ella "veen anu yekolin laasot chobotenu", lepi shemmitzvat reiyya enah ella beshalosh regalim:
Bachatimat habberaka omerim "udebareka emet veku'", ben battepilla ben bahaptara ben baqqiddush, velo yomar "udebareka malkenu" ella "udebareka emet":
"Shehashsholtan" beqama"tz tachat hashshi"n sheniyya shepperusho hammemshala, velo yomar bechiri"q shepperusho adam hashshallit:
En omerim "beahaba miqra qodesh" ella "yom terua miqra qodesh", ubeshabbat "zikron terua miqra qodesh":
Bekol haqqaddishim merosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim omerim "leella [u]leella mikkol birkata":

Venohagin shekkol echad veechad omer lachabero "leshana toba tikkateb", veen lomar dabar zeh beyom sheni shel rosh hashshana achar chatzot hayyom, lepi shekkebar nigmera hakketiba shel rosh hashshana:
